source: Property and command names the native classes of KapowMultiDEDRM.exe (Part 2 PC) register, read from the string pushed at each registration call (1,371 registrations in 143 RegisterMembers functions, 1,224 hashes). Research output: the scan needs the function index of a disassembly, so the table is shipped; every entry is checked on load (name_hash(spelling) == hash) and, when an executable is given, against its bytes.
keep_note: BuiltinModule script globals whose dictionary spelling is also a real name of its own (the PLATFORM enum group, physicsTimepassed__register, Scene in 0x4e2f9d): the dictionary keeps them.
generic_note: Hashes registered with two spellings by different classes: the spelling a reader without class context uses.

native_messages.note: Registration strings of the native messages (589 distinct strings pushed at the 620 calls of 0x50ed51 in KapowMultiDEDRM.exe) by the hash each is registered under: kapow_props.native_message_hash, the name hash of the string with its argument names erased (0x4f9504) up to the first ':' (0x423d30).  The rule is read from code; the hashes are not validated against a sender.
